primary_source_dispositions.assessment: Four-protein PhnI/G/H/L reconstitution makes RPnTP; PhnM hydrolyzes it with MgCl2/ZnCl2 in the assay; anaerobic reconstituted PhnJ requires SAM and reduced Fe-S and yields methane/PRcP. SAM cleavage products were detected. These experiments do not quantify an in vivo SAM/substrate ratio.

primary_source_dispositions.source: EuropePMC indexed primary abstract; publisher full text not obtained
primary_source_dispositions.assessment: Purified PhnP converts synthesized physiological cyclic ribose-phosphate intermediate to ribose1,5bisphosphate. Mutant accumulation supports pathway context. The paper’s proposed PRPP initiation model is not substituted for the later directly reconstituted ATP/PhnI initiation reaction.

primary_source_dispositions.source: EuropePMC indexed primary abstract; attempted full-text endpoints yielded errors/HTML and were not used
locators: abstractText, metal-substitution assay and crystal-structure discussion
primary_source_dispositions.assessment: PhnP shows Mn/Ni preference with bis(p-nitrophenyl)phosphate, poor catalytic Zn substitution, and a separate remote structural Zn site. This is not the direct physiological-substrate identification paper.

PhnGHIJ is a heterooctamer; PhnK binding and Zn sites are structural observations. A persistent PhnJ radical can support turnovers without further SAM consumption. PhnN extends the PhnP product to PRPP, outside this four-reaction source route.

primary_source_dispositions.assessment: Direct ATPase and structural work identifies the PhnK/PhnL double dimer in the larger Phn(GHIJKL)2 machinery; catalytic mutants prevent growth on phosphonates. It does not justify replacing native four-protein assembly composition or adding a reaction-specific PhnK edge to the bounded source route.
